reference.note: The table centre at the mat surface (z = half a tile thickness). The anchor nearest that point is the reference slot and carries scale 1.0; every other slot's scale is reference.depth / slot.depth. The point, the chosen slot and its depth are all published in the JSON.

buckets.note: The plan's standing-hand fan. The boundaries are explicit spec data, not a measurement: Task 4 bakes exactly one blank per name. Bucket representatives come from hand_south, the fan the plan names; the other three hands share the same five blanks for now (their backs are a Task 4 asset decision, not a second bucket family).

One side-wall blank per wall; the plan names wall_left_side / wall_right_side explicitly, so no horizontal split. The representative is the median stack of the run (the vertical axis varies with depth).

The front/back wall runs split into the plan's three horizontal blanks. The boundaries sit in the widest empty gaps of the two runs' merged projected stack positions (0.427/0.443 and 0.557/0.573), so no wall stack straddles a bucket.

Face-up ponds and melds split left/center/right by screen X; a turned tile (riichi discard, called meld tile) appends _rotated, so the plan's six flat blanks are all exercised. The boundaries sit in the empty gaps between the pond groups: the west pond ends at 0.406 and the centre ponds start at 0.431; the centre ponds end at 0.573 and the east pond starts at 0.591.
